ServiceVisit.title: Meet BLS — your partner in car care
ServiceVisit.desc1: Since 2012, we have provided expert care for BMW, MINI and Rolls-Royce vehicles, from diagnostics to engine rebuilds, using quality parts and providing a warranty.
ServiceVisit.desc2: Our experienced team, in-house parts stock and manufacturer-compliant procedures keep every repair efficient and reliable.
ServiceVisit.desc3: We service BMW, MINI and Rolls-Royce vehicles in accordance with manufacturer requirements.

engine.title: Mechanical service — BLS experience and professionalism
engine.desc1: We provide comprehensive automotive mechanical services.
engine.desc2: We combine years of experience with modern BMW-compatible equipment. Our services include diagnostics, repairs, turbocharger regeneration and DPF cleaning.

engineDetail.title: Engine service — power and optimum performance
engineDetail.text: From routine maintenance to complex repairs, precise diagnostics help identify faults early. Timing-system work is performed with particular care.

suspension.title: Suspension — comfort and stability
suspension.text: We diagnose and repair suspension systems, including dampers, springs and chassis components, to restore safe and predictable handling.

oil.title: Oil, filter and fluid replacement
oil.text: Regular oil and fluid changes are essential for engine life. We use suitable products and follow manufacturer procedures.

exhaust.title: Exhaust and silencer service
exhaust.text: We repair complete exhaust systems, including DPF replacement and cleaning as well as centre and rear silencers.

Electrical.title: Automotive electrical services
Electrical.intro: We diagnose and repair electrical systems, electronics and wiring in current and older BMW models using professional ISTA tools and quality measuring equipment.

engine.title: BMW auto electrician — expert diagnostics
engine.desc: We repair alternators, starters, comfort modules, lighting, central locking and engine control units using proven parts and procedures.

suspension.title: BMW electrical-system repair
suspension.desc: Our specialists service older E and F series as well as current G and U series with a focus on safety and reliability.

service.title: Electrical service you can rely on
service.desc: Every repair starts with computer diagnostics and circuit testing, followed by calibration, a road test and clear documentation.
